environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.19.3. The migration-service runs in namespace 'platform-services'. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy named 'migration-svc-access' is applied in the platform-services namespace with spec.selector matching app=migration-service. The policy uses a CUSTOM action delegating to an ext-authz provider ('tenant-authz-grpc') registered in the mesh config extensionProviders. Additionally, a DENY policy named 'block-cross-ns-direct' exists with rules matching source.namespaces not in ['platform-services'] combined with a notPaths exclusion for /healthz. PeerAuthentication is set to STRICT mode. Note: the ext-authz provider validates the x-tenant-context header against the source workload's SPIFFE identity to ensure namespace-to-tenant mapping, but this validation occurs at the application-protocol layer after mTLS termination at the sidecar.
